graph.name: Eden Smart Garden Notification Architecture
graph.notes: Architecture for an IoT smart garden that sends sensor data to AWS IoT Core, triggers Lambda to enrich data with plant metadata and populate Pinpoint endpoint attributes for push notifications, and receives action updates via API Gateway.

nodes.name: Smart Garden Device
nodes.notes: Connected device running FreeRTOS with sensors monitoring water level, relative humidity, and temperature.

nodes.name: Mobile Application
nodes.notes: Receives push notifications from Pinpoint and sends user action updates back to API Gateway.

nodes.name: AWS IoT Core
nodes.notes: Manages MQTT topics, Device Shadow state, and topic rules for triggering backend processes.

nodes.name: AWS Lambda
nodes.notes: Processes state change events, combines plant/user metadata from the database, and updates Pinpoint endpoint attributes.

nodes.name: Amazon Pinpoint
nodes.notes: Manages segments, campaigns, and user notification journeys based on endpoint attributes.

nodes.name: Amazon API Gateway
nodes.notes: Receives user feedback and action updates from the mobile app.

nodes.name: Metadata Database
nodes.notes: Stores plant metadata (e.g., date planted, plant type) and user action feedback.
